controls.qualification: 16 paired noise draws per case on one opened geometry; Gaussian PSF and oracle noise, not independent sky validation

limitations: Opened WISE geometry and development-only synthetic Gaussian truth; no independent sky validation or science promotion.
Control background uses empirical original VARIANCE, which may already contain original source shot noise; added synthetic Poisson does not establish a physical noise budget.
Control errors use oracle expected-source variance; no confidence interval, coverage or detection probability.

Renderer and linear KKT replayed at saved fit positions; successful final-start costs checked independently by linear BVLS, without positional optimization. Position Jacobian/rank is not independently recomputed.
No statistical model winner is selected; 16 draws per case share one opened geometry.

runtime.thread_qualification: environment requests recorded before CLI imports; not independent verification of every backend thread

configurations.spread_basis: all completed pairs, including numerical refusals; model sensitivity only
all completed pairs, including numerical refusals; model sensitivity only

controls.estimands: all attempts/failures, all completed pair error/RMS, common-completed and common-screened pairs; no covariance coverage
controls.fitter_error: oracle sqrt(original variance + known expected-source variance), conditional control only
controls.inference: pilot on one opened geometry; no model selection, validation, coverage calibration or scientific promotion
controls.pixels: same native geometry, original VARIANCE as diagonal Gaussian background-error scale; not injections on original noisy images
controls.psf: axis-aligned pixel-integrated positive Gaussian; independent family from empirical ePSF, not telescope truth
controls.source_noise: exact ideal Poisson OLS ramp of target+neighbors using per-pixel bound gain and nominal header timing

rules.final_mode_audit: nine finite starts with fixed final weights; delta chi2 5.991 is heuristic
rules.neighbor_flux: same semantic native Jy columns, either signed or NNLS >=0; positions fixed from opened catalog
rules.registration: frozen Gaia offsets, fixed; no propagation of shared reference/calibration uncertainty
rules.scope: development on opened 20 WISE wide cutouts; no new sky field
rules.selection: reuse original strict SOURCE-only pixels/errors/catalog IDs; no frame, neighbor or hard case dropped
rules.spatial_psf: nearest or bilinear mixture of individually normalized raw tables, fixed at anchor/catalog coordinates; full native phase normalization follows
rules.target_flux: independent SIGNED Jy per frame; no external spectral ratio or positivity on target
rules.time_model: one position per epoch; within-season motion/parallax not yet fitted
rules.uncertainty: no covariance/confidence/SNR returned for these active-constraint fits
